# JSON Schema Test Suite subset

Source: `json-schema-org/JSON-Schema-Test-Suite`

Commit: `f6fd52a0a95472e079cbfc6ef7f089702b80e045`

`cases.json` contains 43 unmodified test groups selected from the Draft 2020-12 files named by each record. The selection covers schemas that the current compiler can lower to an exact whole-language DFA. The upstream MIT license is retained in this directory.
